victim_update_days.label: Days after registration by which the victim must be updated (law: 90, BNSS 193(3)(ii)); a unit may only choose fewer

import_self_approval.label: Whether the person who checked an import file may also approve it (1 = yes, 0 = a second authorised person must approve); a unit may only choose 0

session_hours.label: Hours a sign-in lasts before the officer signs in again; a unit may only choose fewer
